title: Justin Herbert to throw each day at minicamp, "ramping up" for training camp

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Justin Herbert to throw each day at minicamp, "ramping up" for training camp
sources.description: Chargers quarterback Justin Herbert missed some of the team's voluntary workouts this spring and worked on a modified schedule in some of the practices he attended, but he'll be back in a more familiar routine at minicamp this week.
